ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white-spectrum background on distal lobes transitioning to 30% low-intensity black-spectrum mottling and solid-black central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on the distal lobes containing numerous discrete low-intensity circular and ovoid blobs (mottling). High-intensity dark pigmentation is concentrated along the anterior leading edges and the central longitudinal axis joining the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Approximately 12-18 distinct peaks per lobe with pixel-depth variances ranging from 10 to 50 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature extending from the central axis toward the distal tips; the trailing edge follows a generally outward-curving arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular textures (barnacle colonization) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along several prominent trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe ventral surface, intersecting the primary pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy physical accumulation of barnacle clusters at the fluke tips, altering the natural geometric boundary and creating a high-relief, irregular texture.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'eye-spot' pigmentation pattern (dark ring with light center) located on the mid-proximal region of the left lobe.
